name: No One-Size-Fits-All MTS Forecasting Benchmark
description: A systematic evaluation suite comparing multivariate time series forecasting methods across diverse datasets and settings to identify robust performers.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by dataset and horizon; no single SOTA (dataset-dependent)
reputation: Recognized in the time-series forecasting research community for systematic cross-dataset comparisons; moderate adoption in academic benchmarking studies.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark focused on classical and deep forecasting methods; evaluates multiple error metrics across heterogeneous datasets so results are dataset- and metric-dependent; risk of overfitting to particular datasets when tuning models.
